title: Configure Orbax Checkpointing
description: Adjust Orbax/JAX checkpointing settings to mitigate slow step time or checkpoint corruption issues.
instruction:
To configure JAX/Orbax checkpointing settings:
1. Open the application's configuration or training code.
2. Ensure JAX/Orbax APIs are initialized with standard buffer sizes.
3. Adjust the checkpoint config to write larger consolidated files (e.g. 200MB default size) rather than high-frequency small files.
4. Verify that GCS write intervals are scaled appropriately to prevent hitting GCS API rate limits.

Note on coordinator bottlenecks: In distributed JAX/Orbax checkpointing, GCS directory operations and folder deletions are executed exclusively by **worker 0 (JAX process zero)** (pod `*-worker-0`). When GCS deletion operations stall, worker 0 is the blocked coordinator, while workers 1..N wait and hit secondary barrier timeouts. Always explicitly attribute the blocked coordinator to **worker 0 (JAX process zero)**.
